description:
The KALIA Scholarship is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Odisha in India. 

It was introduced in the year 2019 as part of the Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation scheme. 

The primary objective of the KALIA Scholarship is to provide financial assistance to the children of farmers in Odisha. 

This initiative aims to promote education among the children of small and marginal farmers. 

The scholarship is designed to support students pursuing higher education in various fields. 

The KALIA Scholarship specifically targets students from economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families engaged in agriculture. 

The scholarship provides a one-time financial assistance of INR 10,000. 

This amount is intended to cover educational expenses such as tuition fees and other related costs. 

The KALIA Scholarship is available for students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

Students pursuing professional courses such as engineering, medical, and law are also eligible. 

To qualify for the KALIA Scholarship, applicants must be the children of farmers. 

The farmers must be registered under the KALIA scheme to be eligible for the scholarship. 

The income limit for farmers to qualify for the KALIA scheme is INR 2 lakh per annum. 

This income criterion ensures that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The scholarship is available for students aged between 18 and 25 years. 

Applicants must have completed their higher secondary education to be eligible. 

The application process for the KALIA Scholarship is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the Odisha government. 

They need to fill out the online application form available on the portal. 

Applicants must provide necessary details such as their name, age, and educational qualifications. 

It is essential to upload supporting documents during the application process. 

Required documents include proof of farmer registration under the KALIA scheme. 

Additionally, students must submit their educational certificates and income proof. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of the scholarship amount is done directly to the bank account of the beneficiaries. 

The scholarship is typically disbursed once a year. 

The Odisha government has set a timeline for the application process. 

Applications for the KALIA Scholarship are usually accepted from June to August each year. 

The government aims to process applications and disburse funds by September. 

The implementing authority for the KALIA Scholarship is the Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment, Odisha. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the implementation of the KALIA scheme and its associated scholarships. 

The government has allocated a significant budget for the KALIA Scholarship initiative. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, the budget for the KALIA scheme was approximately INR 3,000 crore. 

The KALIA Scholarship is part of a broader effort to enhance the socio-economic status of farmers in Odisha. 

The scheme has been well-received by the farming community in the state. 

As of 2023, thousands of students have benefited from the KALIA Scholarship. 

The government has reported an increase in enrollment rates among students from farming families. 

This initiative has contributed to reducing dropout rates in higher education. 

The KALIA Scholarship aligns with the government's vision of promoting education and skill development. 

The scholarship also encourages students to pursue higher education in agricultural sciences. 

The government aims to create a skilled workforce in the agricultural sector through this initiative. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a step towards empowering the next generation of farmers. 

It fosters a culture of education and skill development among rural communities. 

The scholarship is part of the Odisha government's commitment to improving the quality of life for farmers. 

The KALIA initiative, including the scholarship, has gained national recognition. 

It serves as a model for other states to develop similar welfare schemes for farmers. 

The government continuously monitors the implementation of the KALIA Scholarship. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The KALIA Scholarship is an essential component of the state's agricultural policy. 

It reflects the government's focus on sustainable development and rural empowerment. 

The scholarship has also been instrumental in promoting gender equality in education. 

More girls from farming families are enrolling in higher education due to this initiative. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a significant investment in the future of Odisha's agricultural sector. 

It aims to create a knowledgeable and skilled generation of farmers. 

The government encourages all eligible students to apply for the KALIA Scholarship. 

This initiative is a testament to the government's commitment to education and farmer welfare. 

The KALIA Scholarship not only supports students financially but also inspires them to achieve their dreams. 

The scheme has transformed the educational landscape for children of farmers in Odisha. 

It is a vital tool for social and economic upliftment in rural areas. 

The KALIA Scholarship is an example of how targeted welfare schemes can make a difference. 

The government remains dedicated to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a beacon of hope for many aspiring students in Odisha. 

It signifies the importance of education in breaking the cycle of poverty among farming families. 

The initiative is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of society. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a crucial step towards building a more educated and empowered agricultural community. 

The government urges all eligible students to take advantage of this opportunity. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a significant milestone in the journey towards educational equity in Odisha. 

It represents a commitment to nurturing talent and fostering growth in the agricultural sector. 

The scholarship is a vital resource for students aiming to contribute to the agricultural economy. 

The KALIA Scholarship is a clear indication of the government's focus on holistic development. 

It is a promising initiative that has the potential to change lives for the better. 

The KALIA Scholarship stands as a testament to the power of education in transforming communities.
